cause_quote: The new candidate canary started the candidate Gateway on a private state copy with `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR: tempDir` and `delete copied.env`, never providing the credentials/ files or env vars that exec SecretRef providers such as 1Password read at boot.
user_saw: `openclaw update` failed at candidate-gateway-startup with runtime-verification-failed and rolled back whenever a boot-time SecretRef used the 1Password exec provider.
summary: During private update rehearsal, exec secret providers are deferred, failing and unowned secret owners are kept cold instead of blocking startup, and a warning is recorded in the snapshot receipt.
reasoning: Issue #192066 shows the rehearsal's private state copy lacks credentials/ and config env, so the exec provider fails and the candidate Gateway refuses to start. The candidate canary that starts a Gateway on an isolated state copy was introduced by d1a69c0b2095 (Sept 2026, its diff adds OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR: tempDir and delete copied.env) and later moved into update-candidate-rehearsal.ts by 76bf977faef; the 1Password exec plugin already existed (July 2026), so the combination never worked. Medium because I did not confirm the Gateway's strict startup secret check behaved identically at d1a69c0.
